user.title: BRUH Cooking
user.description: Log in with the account you use in the Breville+ Cooking app, or in Sage's version of it.

data_description.email: The email address of your Breville or Sage account.
data_description.password: Your password is only sent to Breville. Home Assistant keeps a login session, not the password.
data_description.brand: The brand of your app and appliances: Sage in the UK, Europe and the UAE, and Breville elsewhere.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Breville session for {email} has expired. Enter your password to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Breville. Try again later.
error.mfa_not_supported: This account uses multi-factor authentication, which isn't supported yet.

abort.already_configured: This Breville account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That's a different Breville account from the one set up here.

init.description: Some appliances haven't been tested with this integration yet, so Home Assistant only monitors them. Stopping a cook always works.

data_description.allow_untested_control: Also start and change cooks on untested appliances. Only turn this on when you can keep an eye on the appliance, and please report how it goes.
data_description.show_sidebar_panel: Show this account's appliances in a sidebar panel, with a live drawing of each and its controls. Everyone who uses Home Assistant sees it.

state.waiting_for_button: Press the button on the appliance

start_cook.name: Start cook
start_cook.description: Starts a cook with the given settings. Target the appliance's Cook switch. Anything left out uses the appliance's current settings.

temperature.name: Temperature

duration.description: Cook time. For sous vide, leave it out to hold the temperature until stopped.

convection.description: Oven fan setting, if the mode allows it.

level.name: Level

auto_start_timer.description: Start the timer once the temperature is reached instead of waiting for the food to go in.
